headline: Youth Employment Deficit Costs Peru at Least 1.1% of Annual GDP
summary: The lack of study and work opportunities for Peruvian youth costs the economy at least 1.1% of GDP annually. Employing idle youth would generate S/13.78 billion per year.
why: Peru faces structural labor informalities and economic challenges amplified by weather events and automation risks.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Youth labor market underutilization depresses domestic economic output.
